page.overview:
Who is Felice Bonetto?

Felice Bonetto (June 9, 1903 - November 21, 1953) was a courageous Italian racer who earned the nickname Il Pirata (The Pirate). He came to the attention of Italian racers in the 1930s and internationally in the 1940s, enjoying success at the Mille Miglia, and grand prix successes driving a and a Cisitilia.

During his Formula 1 career, Il Pirata raced Italian cars, starting with a privateer Maserati team, then the factory team and finally with the factory team and achieved two shared podiums.

Bonetto's greatest successes were in sports cars, including a win at the Targa Florio in 1952, but sadly his career was cut short when he hit his head on the balcony of a house in the 1953 Carrera Panamericana.

In 1949 Bonetto came second in the Naples GP and also took sports car success with second at the Mille Miglia.
